## About

Ival Permana is a Computer Engineering student, Software Developer, and Product Builder. He specializes in Web Development, Mobile Applications, and AI Product Development. He builds end-to-end digital products from idea to deployment.

## Skills & Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React.js, Vue.js 3, Tailwind CSS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- **Backend**: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Laravel
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Dart
- **Database**: PostgreSQL, Firebase (Firestore, Auth), Redis
- **DevOps**: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, Self-hosted Server
- **AI/ML**: Groq API, LLaMA 3, AI-powered product development
- **Other**: Git, REST API, Cloudinary, Google Maps API, Leaflet.js

## Projects

### LinkinBio AI
Smart bio link generator powered by AI. Built with Vue.js 3, Laravel 11, Tailwind v4, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Groq API.
- URL: https://link-bio-puce.vercel.app/

### EcoTrace
Environmental tracking and report management web app. Built with React.js, Firebase, Tailwind, Leaflet.js, and Cloudinary.
- URL: https://ecotrace-id.vercel.app/

### CodeTack
Developer code snippet organization tool. Built with HTML, CSS, Tailwind, and JavaScript.
- URL: https://justrahyan.github.io/CodeTack/

### ResearchFinder
AI-powered research paper search and summarization platform. Built with Vue.js 3, FastAPI, Groq API, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Tailwind v4, Pinia, and Docker.
- URL: https://github.com/Vals-devs/ReaserchHelper.git

### SiagaDarah
Blood donation emergency mobile app. Built with Flutter, Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, Firebase Messaging, and Google Maps API.
